## 1. Game example

Short sentences. One idea per sentence. Start from a game the students know.

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 2"}
One short instruction. Each question is matched with its answer
(the student taps the answer and sees at once if it is right).

::: {.match}
First question?
:   its answer

Second question?
:   its answer
:::
:::

## 2. Picture, then the rule

![Caption in simple English.](sims/name.png){width=85%}

Explain the picture. Only then show the rule or formula.

::: {.callout-note title="Example: one short title"}
1. First step, with the numbers.
2. Second step.
3. The answer in **bold**. Check it, if you can.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Watch out!"}
One common mistake, and how to avoid it.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 3"}
Question about the picture. With only 1–2 questions, add wrong answers in `extra`.

::: {.match extra="wrong answer 1|wrong answer 2"}
Question about the picture?
:   the right answer

Same rule, a little harder?
:   the right answer

The reverse question (answer → question)?
:   the right answer
:::
:::
